source.note: The handoff's ZIP (requirements.json, acceptance-tests.json, workstreams.json, contracts/, examples/, validate_handoff.py) was not supplied; these come from its combined Markdown

requirements.title: Frozen inventory
requirements.requirement: Record current repository commits, dirty files, lock digests, features and installed app versions before modifying code.

requirements.title: Existing capability reuse
requirements.requirement: Map each proposed capability to current source and tests before creating a new implementation.

requirements.title: Prior invariant regressions
requirements.requirement: Revalidate earlier execution findings against the actual assembled release.

requirements.title: Release pins
requirements.requirement: Generate release inventory from actual lockfiles and artifact builds.

requirements.title: Worktree safety
requirements.requirement: Preserve uncommitted changes and validate unused local patches.

requirements.title: Frozen and forward CI
requirements.requirement: Separate exact-release qualification from latest-compatible dependency testing.

requirements.title: Evidence classification
requirements.requirement: Distinguish source, mock, provider and hardware evidence.

requirements.title: Feature inventory
requirements.requirement: Discover inaccessible and private components without assuming their absence.

requirements.title: Tenant context
requirements.requirement: Derive trusted tenant scope from identity and membership, never a browser tenant header.

requirements.title: Scoped delegation
requirements.requirement: Intersect user authority with workload and resource grants.

requirements.title: Separation of duties
requirements.requirement: Require independent approval for sensitive capability changes.

requirements.title: Immutable approval
requirements.requirement: Bind approval to artifact, config, resource plan and policy digests.

requirements.title: Subject lifecycle
requirements.requirement: Use immutable subject IDs and explicit tenant memberships.

requirements.title: Federation security
requirements.requirement: Implement qualified OAuth/OIDC flows and issuer/audience checks.

requirements.title: Downstream offboarding
requirements.requirement: Track revocation independently for Git, sessions, private peers and privileged credentials.

requirements.title: Policy freshness
requirements.requirement: Track effective policy revisions at enforcement points.

requirements.title: Emergency access
requirements.requirement: Provide protected, audited recovery independent of the failed primary IdP.

requirements.title: Negative authorization matrix
requirements.requirement: Test every API through ordinary roles and service identities.

requirements.title: Repository lifecycle
requirements.requirement: Support create, archive, restore, delete-retain and portable export with ownership.

requirements.title: Ref consistency
requirements.requirement: Preserve expected-old-value and protected-reference checks on every Git transport.

requirements.title: Git storage authority
requirements.requirement: Qualify repository storage and failover rather than assume generic S3 filesystem semantics.

requirements.title: Backup completeness
requirements.requirement: Restore repository objects, refs, metadata, LFS and required forge configuration together.

requirements.title: Scoped Git credentials
requirements.requirement: Bind PATs, SSH/deploy keys and build tokens to required repositories and actions.

requirements.title: Server hook restriction
requirements.requirement: Disallow tenant executable hooks inside trusted Git service.

requirements.title: Import and mirror egress
requirements.requirement: Apply route, redirect, DNS and credential restrictions to imports and mirrors.

requirements.title: Git resource limits
requirements.requirement: Bound pack, object, process, CPU, storage and concurrency consumption.

requirements.title: PR approval integrity
requirements.requirement: Require protected checks/reviews for the exact candidate source.

requirements.title: LFS access
requirements.requirement: Enforce repository authorization for LFS reads, uploads and signed URLs.

requirements.title: Forge outage isolation
requirements.requirement: Keep existing runtime sites independent of forge availability.

requirements.title: Repository portability
requirements.requirement: Export standard Git and documented review/configuration metadata.

requirements.title: Webhook authenticity
requirements.requirement: Authenticate, deduplicate and bind source events to approved repositories.

requirements.title: Exact commit checkout
requirements.requirement: Build the recorded immutable commit and record submodule/LFS inputs.

requirements.title: Builder sandbox
requirements.requirement: Execute repository scripts and dependency hooks in disposable isolated workers.

requirements.title: Production isolation
requirements.requirement: Deny build and preview access to production data, payments and OT routes.

requirements.title: Secret exposure controls
requirements.requirement: Avoid unnecessary build secrets and scope necessary temporary package credentials.

requirements.title: Cache trust
requirements.requirement: Partition mutable caches by tenant and source trust level.

requirements.title: Dependency pinning
requirements.requirement: Pin builder images, package locks and executable build dependencies.

requirements.title: Artifact finalization
requirements.requirement: Publish immutable artifacts only through a trusted finalizer.

requirements.title: Signing authority
requirements.requirement: Keep production signing authority outside untrusted build execution.

requirements.title: Provenance privacy
requirements.requirement: Protect private repository and customer metadata in attestations.

requirements.title: Build cancellation
requirements.requirement: Cancel sandbox work, revoke temporary identity and clean unused outputs.

requirements.title: Tenant fairness
requirements.requirement: Schedule builds under per-tenant concurrency and budget controls.

requirements.title: Log safety
requirements.requirement: Authenticate logs and escape untrusted control content.

requirements.title: Customer runner trust
requirements.requirement: Label customer-runner artifacts with their actual assurance level.

requirements.title: Environment separation
requirements.requirement: Maintain separate identities, bindings and caches per environment.

requirements.title: Release immutability
requirements.requirement: Bind release to artifact, config, policy, runtime and resource-schema versions.

requirements.title: Promotion serialization
requirements.requirement: Prevent two promotions from interleaving one environment's route and schema state.

requirements.title: Readiness gating
requirements.requirement: Route traffic only to verified ready instances.

requirements.title: Migration compatibility
requirements.requirement: Use serialized expand/contract migrations and explicit rollback limits.

requirements.title: Preview access
requirements.requirement: Protect previews through every hostname and direct origin.

requirements.title: Preview cleanup
requirements.requirement: Expire previews, credentials and orphan resources without deleting retained artifacts in use.

requirements.title: Graceful rollout
requirements.requirement: Drain requests and handle long-lived connections under bounded policy.

requirements.title: Rollback correctness
requirements.requirement: Rollback selects a coherent compatible release, not only an old image.

requirements.title: Durable background work
requirements.requirement: Put long-running effects in managed jobs rather than untracked SSR tasks.

requirements.title: Scheduler semantics
requirements.requirement: Define timezone, DST, missed-run and overlap behavior for schedules.

requirements.title: Capability reconsent
requirements.requirement: Require renewed consent for runtime/network/resource permission expansion.

requirements.title: Serving independence
requirements.requirement: Keep deployed site serving when management and build systems are unavailable.

requirements.title: Public/private cache separation
requirements.requirement: Never place personalized responses in public shared cache by default.

requirements.title: Framework conformance
requirements.requirement: Qualify each framework/runtime combination across supported features.

requirements.title: Deployment skew
requirements.requirement: Retain old assets and coordinate framework deployment-sensitive state.

requirements.title: Browser origin isolation
requirements.requirement: Separate untrusted content from management origin and control cookies.

requirements.title: Domain ownership
requirements.requirement: Verify normalized domain ownership and uniqueness before routing.

requirements.title: Origin bypass
requirements.requirement: Apply access policy to all ingress paths and reject unknown hosts.

requirements.title: Certificate lifecycle
requirements.requirement: Handle issuance, rate limits, renewal and transfer with scoped provider credentials.

requirements.title: Image and fetch SSRF
requirements.requirement: Enforce destination policy on image optimization and server-side URL fetches.

requirements.title: Request resource budgets
requirements.requirement: Bound uploads, headers, decompression and runtime concurrency.

requirements.title: Upload finalization
requirements.requirement: Scan and verify objects before making them application-visible.

requirements.title: Storefront authority
requirements.requirement: Keep pricing, tax, stock, customer ownership and payment state in backend actions.

requirements.title: Headless content lifecycle
requirements.requirement: Provide drafts, revision, locale and approved publishing semantics.

requirements.title: Logical resource binding
requirements.requirement: Separate declared capability from provider instance and workload binding.

requirements.title: Idempotent provisioning
requirements.requirement: Reconcile ambiguous provider creation before retrying.

requirements.title: Required resource readiness
requirements.requirement: Do not activate an app before required resources and migrations verify.

requirements.title: Tenant database isolation
requirements.requirement: Enforce tenant scope beyond query parameterization.

requirements.title: Scoped credentials
requirements.requirement: Separate runtime and migrator roles and rotate bindings safely.

requirements.title: Resource migration
requirements.requirement: Serialize checksum-versioned migrations with bounded locks and resumable backfill.

requirements.title: Provider capability mismatch
requirements.requirement: Reject required semantics unavailable from selected backend.

requirements.title: Data authority classification
requirements.requirement: Identify primary, derived, archival and disposable datasets.

requirements.title: Object consistency
requirements.requirement: Reconcile object metadata and bytes without claiming distributed ACID.

requirements.title: Backup semantics
requirements.requirement: Record resource backups, keys and logical consistency points.

requirements.title: Customer resource detachment
requirements.requirement: Retain customer-owned resources on uninstall unless explicit authority says otherwise.

requirements.title: Destructive deletion controls
requirements.requirement: Check retention, legal hold and dependencies before destruction.

requirements.title: Query console safety
requirements.requirement: Use scoped short-lived access and read-only defaults for administrative queries.

requirements.title: Licensing gate
requirements.requirement: Approve exact engine edition/feature/hosting rights before managed distribution.

requirements.title: Resource portability
requirements.requirement: Provide export formats and restore path per resource class.

requirements.title: Single scaler owner
requirements.requirement: Use one authoritative controller per scaling target.

requirements.title: Connection budgeting
requirements.requirement: Account for API, worker, plugin, listener and migration connections.

requirements.title: Stateful scaling
requirements.requirement: Use engine-specific scaling with replication and migration guards.

requirements.title: Budget enforcement
requirements.requirement: Separate alerts, estimates and enforced admission caps.

requirements.title: Critical reserve
requirements.requirement: Protect durable command/evidence capacity before shedding telemetry.

requirements.title: Gateway drain
requirements.requirement: Scale connection services using ownership-aware drain.

requirements.title: Noisy neighbor
requirements.requirement: Maintain per-tenant fairness and shared-resource quotas.

requirements.title: Capacity evidence
requirements.requirement: Attach profile limits to measured artifacts and hardware.

requirements.title: Reachability versus rights
requirements.requirement: Require application authorization even over a private tunnel.

requirements.title: Provider administration isolation
requirements.requirement: Separate tenant network/proxy administration scopes.

requirements.title: Posture trust
requirements.requirement: Use qualified fresh device evidence rather than asset metadata alone.

requirements.title: Private connectors
requirements.requirement: Expose only approved resources through outbound-authenticated connectors.

requirements.title: Overlapping addresses
requirements.requirement: Isolate customers using identical private CIDRs.

requirements.title: Revocation coverage
requirements.requirement: Revoke web, Git, tunnel and privileged sessions with per-provider completion.

requirements.title: Privileged session scope
requirements.requirement: Use target/action-scoped temporary grants for administration.

requirements.title: Header spoofing
requirements.requirement: Accept identity assertions only from authenticated trusted proxies.

requirements.title: Access outage policy
requirements.requirement: Define cache expiry and fail behavior per resource risk.

requirements.title: OT access boundary
requirements.requirement: Keep industrial support separate from ordinary employee connectivity.

requirements.title: Secret indirection
requirements.requirement: Store references and lease metadata rather than plaintext in app config.

requirements.title: Workload attestation
requirements.requirement: Issue service identity only to the approved deployment/job context.

requirements.title: Root rotation
requirements.requirement: Rotate signing/trust roots with staged verification and compromise handling.

requirements.title: Key recovery
requirements.requirement: Maintain a protected independent recovery procedure for encrypted backups.

requirements.title: Credential expiry
requirements.requirement: Define online/offline behavior for expired credentials and trust bundles.

requirements.title: Environment secret scope
requirements.requirement: Prevent production secret copying into previews and public build variables.

requirements.title: Compromise response
requirements.requirement: Revoke affected identities and reconcile deployments after key compromise.

requirements.title: Operator visibility honesty
requirements.requirement: Describe hosting/key access accurately.

requirements.title: Transactional outbox
requirements.requirement: Commit authoritative state and outbox together.

requirements.title: Consumer idempotency
requirements.requirement: Apply inbox receipt and local business effect atomically where possible.

requirements.title: External ambiguity
requirements.requirement: Reconcile nontransactional effects before retrying uncertain outcomes.

requirements.title: Lease fencing
requirements.requirement: Prevent stale workers from committing or dispatching beyond ownership.

requirements.title: Notification recovery
requirements.requirement: Use notification as hint with durable polling/replay fallback.

requirements.title: Cursor correctness
requirements.requirement: Use committed gap-safe event cursors rather than raw uncommitted sequence assumptions.

requirements.title: Snapshot subscription
requirements.requirement: Avoid race between snapshot and live subscription.

requirements.title: Contract evolution
requirements.requirement: Version events/actions and reject unsupported mandatory semantics.

requirements.title: Regional authority
requirements.requirement: Use one write authority or qualified conflict protocol for critical resources.

requirements.title: Service delegation
requirements.requirement: Validate workload plus tenant/user context downstream.

requirements.title: Any-replica intake
requirements.requirement: Persist request before acknowledging and expose stable status ID.

requirements.title: Exact connection owner
requirements.requirement: Route device work only to current authenticated owner/generation.

requirements.title: Reconnect generation
requirements.requirement: Protect new connection from old disconnect and stale sender.

requirements.title: Physical intent deduplication
requirements.requirement: Scope idempotency to business intent and reject payload mismatch.

requirements.title: Final deadline gate
requirements.requirement: Recheck deadline and authority immediately before external send.

requirements.title: Clock correctness
requirements.requirement: Do not extend authorization through backward wall-clock changes.

requirements.title: Recovery target binding
requirements.requirement: Persist exact target/adapter/configuration binding for recovery.

requirements.title: Inbound durability
requirements.requirement: Persist critical protocol evidence/response identity before durable acknowledgment.

requirements.title: Protocol versus business outcome
requirements.requirement: Distinguish request acceptance, session creation and charging evidence.

requirements.title: Durable correlation
requirements.requirement: Persist protocol IDs, station/EVSE/connector and transaction mapping.

requirements.title: Safe unknown outcome
requirements.requirement: Never infer failure from timeout after possible execution.

requirements.title: Meter evidence
requirements.requirement: Preserve units, multiplier, quality and target dimensions needed for billing.

requirements.title: Critical quota behavior
requirements.requirement: Keep stop/report/reconciliation paths independent of optional usage caps.

requirements.title: Client replay
requirements.requirement: Recover live status after dropped notifications and cursor expiry.

requirements.title: Execution trust classes
requirements.requirement: Distinguish meta, WASM, native and isolated service extensions.

requirements.title: Manifest versioning
requirements.requirement: Reject unknown or unsupported required fields in package contracts.

requirements.title: Capability consent
requirements.requirement: Display and approve new permissions/resources/network cost at install and upgrade.

requirements.title: Host resource scoping
requirements.requirement: Derive tenant/application scope for WASM resource handles from host context.

requirements.title: UI isolation
requirements.requirement: Keep arbitrary extension UI from general shell sessions.

requirements.title: Dependency safety
requirements.requirement: Review transitive extensions and privileges.

requirements.title: Lifecycle cleanup
requirements.requirement: Revoke bindings and retain data correctly when disabling/uninstalling.

requirements.title: Certification scope
requirements.requirement: Tie labels to artifact, capabilities, provider profile and evidence.

requirements.title: Deprecation migration
requirements.requirement: Provide supported migration/export for retired extension.

requirements.title: Core invariants
requirements.requirement: Prevent configurable scripts/workflows from overriding shared business invariants.

requirements.title: Agent capability boundary
requirements.requirement: Constrain AI tools independently of natural-language output.

requirements.title: Model/provider policy
requirements.requirement: Bind model features to approved region, data handling and cost.

requirements.title: Approval integrity
requirements.requirement: Bind approved AI action plan and prohibit self-approval.

requirements.title: Development sandbox
requirements.requirement: Default local AI/developer clients to synthetic sandbox resources.

requirements.title: Budget and cancellation
requirements.requirement: Bound model/tool calls, concurrency and repeated attempts.

requirements.title: Evidence and abstention
requirements.requirement: Require freshness/provenance and explicit unknown results.

requirements.title: Data boundary disclosure
requirements.requirement: Describe remote processing accurately for local AI tools.

requirements.title: Operational autonomy
requirements.requirement: Keep safety control outside ordinary AI automation.

requirements.title: Consistent scope UI
requirements.requirement: Show tenant, project, environment and production context on management actions.

requirements.title: Asynchronous UX
requirements.requirement: Preserve operation status across refresh and browser reconnect.

requirements.title: Accessible administration
requirements.requirement: Meet declared WCAG 2.2 AA target with automated and manual checks.

requirements.title: Localization correctness
requirements.requirement: Separate translated display from exact stored/API values.

requirements.title: Permission explanation
requirements.requirement: Explain denied/disabled actions without hidden-resource leakage.

requirements.title: Operator recovery UX
requirements.requirement: Provide meaningful uncertain/partial states and authorized recovery.

requirements.title: Bundle provenance
requirements.requirement: Build and verify distributed UI from intended source revision.

requirements.title: Audit visibility
requirements.requirement: Make approvals, support and policy changes inspectable by customer.

requirements.title: Telemetry correlation
requirements.requirement: Correlate build, release, resource and command paths without logging secrets.

requirements.title: Tenant telemetry isolation
requirements.requirement: Authorize log/trace queries beyond user-supplied label filters.

requirements.title: Bounded cardinality
requirements.requirement: Bound metric dimensions and handle high-volume detail separately.

requirements.title: Operational alert coverage
requirements.requirement: Alert on drift, backlog, unknown outcomes, expiry and backup age.

requirements.title: Metering idempotency
requirements.requirement: Deduplicate usage and retain price-plan version for invoices.

requirements.title: Money precision
requirements.requirement: Use exact money/quantity calculations for billing.

requirements.title: Budget transparency
requirements.requirement: Distinguish forecast, alert and enforced cap.

requirements.title: Incident process
requirements.requirement: Maintain severity, communications, evidence and postmortem workflow.

requirements.title: Abuse controls
requirements.requirement: Manage phishing, crypto-mining, spam and uncontrolled public hosting.

requirements.title: Tenant lifecycle
requirements.requirement: Implement signup/provision/plan/grace/restrict/close/retain/delete as auditable workflows.

requirements.title: Official partner scope
requirements.requirement: Implement Cloud partner program without removing open-source rights.

requirements.title: Support least privilege
requirements.requirement: Grant named, expiring customer-approved support capabilities.

requirements.title: No standing partner admin
requirements.requirement: Prevent partner status from granting hidden superuser access.

requirements.title: Support revocation
requirements.requirement: Terminate support access and track active sessions.

requirements.title: Residency coverage
requirements.requirement: Apply region policy to logs, backups, builds, caches and AI as well as database.

requirements.title: Account restriction safety
requirements.requirement: Preserve export and required operational recovery under billing restriction.

requirements.title: Customer controlled profile
requirements.requirement: Define operator permissions and local dependency envelope for customer VPC.

requirements.title: Service ownership
requirements.requirement: Assign maintainer, support period and escalation per marketed service.

requirements.title: Complete backups
requirements.requirement: Include authoritative databases, repositories, objects, keys and binding/config evidence.

requirements.title: Restore isolation
requirements.requirement: Disable external effects until reconciliation after restore.

requirements.title: Tenant-level recovery
requirements.requirement: Use an isolated recovery extraction path for shared-database PITR.

requirements.title: Key recovery test
requirements.requirement: Verify protected recovery of keys required by encrypted backups.

requirements.title: Failover fencing
requirements.requirement: Fence old writers before promoting new regional owners.

requirements.title: Object and Git integrity
requirements.requirement: Verify checksums, ref/object reachability and LFS linkage after recovery.

requirements.title: Capacity recovery
requirements.requirement: Control backlog replay and reconnect storms after outage.

requirements.title: Update trust
requirements.requirement: Validate signed metadata, artifact identity, expiry and rollback protections.

requirements.title: Runbook exercise
requirements.requirement: Exercise clean install, upgrade, rotation, restore, export and vendor retirement.

requirements.title: RPO RTO evidence
requirements.requirement: Measure recovery objectives under declared fault model.

requirements.title: Requirement traceability
requirements.requirement: Map each supported claim to exact test/evidence and release profile.

requirements.title: Security baseline
requirements.requirement: Pin applicable ASVS/SSDF controls and record exceptions.

requirements.title: Independent review
requirements.requirement: Require external assurance where the sold profile demands it.

requirements.title: Provider qualification
requirements.requirement: Test real provider sandbox/tenant for claimed integrations.

requirements.title: Hardware qualification
requirements.requirement: Tie device support to model, firmware, protocol and site evidence.

requirements.title: Golden journeys
requirements.requirement: Execute all applicable documented end-to-end journeys against release artifacts.

requirements.title: Mutation and fault coverage
requirements.requirement: Test invariants under deliberate internal faults and logic mutations.

requirements.title: Release evidence integrity
requirements.requirement: Generate and protect source, pin, artifact, test and approval evidence.

requirements.title: Supported limits
requirements.requirement: Publish exact runtime/provider/profile limits and known exclusions.

acceptance.title: Frozen inventory
acceptance.behaviour: Record current repository commits, dirty files, lock digests, features and installed app versions before modifying code.
acceptance.exercise: Compare default branch, pinned dependency, image and tenant-installed versions.
acceptance.acceptance: All four are distinguishable; no unrelated work is overwritten.

acceptance.title: Existing capability reuse
acceptance.behaviour: Map each proposed capability to current source and tests before creating a new implementation.
acceptance.exercise: Select identity, outbox, files, Operations and Commerce paths and trace their call chains.
acceptance.acceptance: Existing authoritative domains are reused or a reviewed ADR explains replacement.

acceptance.title: Prior invariant regressions
acceptance.behaviour: Revalidate earlier execution findings against the actual assembled release.
acceptance.exercise: Run duplicate-release, recovery-binding, clock, dependency, material and audit tests as ordinary roles.
acceptance.acceptance: Each finding has a current result; documentation alone does not close it.

acceptance.title: Release pins
acceptance.behaviour: Generate release inventory from actual lockfiles and artifact builds.
acceptance.exercise: Change an app pin without rebuilding its UI or updating tenant version.
acceptance.acceptance: Qualification detects the inconsistent assembly and blocks promotion.

acceptance.title: Worktree safety
acceptance.behaviour: Preserve uncommitted changes and validate unused local patches.
acceptance.exercise: Run baseline tooling in a workspace with unrelated dirty files and unused patch entries.
acceptance.acceptance: Tool reports them; no destructive reset or bulk commit occurs.

acceptance.title: Frozen and forward CI
acceptance.behaviour: Separate exact-release qualification from latest-compatible dependency testing.
acceptance.exercise: Advance a dependency branch while a frozen qualification run is executing.
acceptance.acceptance: Frozen inputs stay immutable and forward compatibility results are separately labeled.

acceptance.title: Evidence classification
acceptance.behaviour: Distinguish source, mock, provider and hardware evidence.
acceptance.exercise: Present a simulator-only successful test for a device qualification claim.
acceptance.acceptance: Claim remains software-only and hardware gate remains open.

acceptance.title: Feature inventory
acceptance.behaviour: Discover inaccessible and private components without assuming their absence.
acceptance.exercise: Make a repository inaccessible while its manifest dependency exists.
acceptance.acceptance: Inventory records an access limitation and does not fabricate a missing implementation.

acceptance.title: Tenant context
acceptance.behaviour: Derive trusted tenant scope from identity and membership, never a browser tenant header.
acceptance.exercise: Authenticated tenant A submits tenant B identifiers and spoofed scope headers.
acceptance.acceptance: All reads and writes fail without leaking whether B objects exist.

acceptance.title: Scoped delegation
acceptance.behaviour: Intersect user authority with workload and resource grants.
acceptance.exercise: A permitted service forwards a low-privilege user's request to a broader internal API.
acceptance.acceptance: The downstream action remains bounded by applicable user authority.

acceptance.title: Separation of duties
acceptance.behaviour: Require independent approval for sensitive capability changes.
acceptance.exercise: Developer requests production database administration and attempts self-approval.
acceptance.acceptance: Self-approval fails through UI, API and automation tools.

acceptance.title: Immutable approval
acceptance.behaviour: Bind approval to artifact, config, resource plan and policy digests.
acceptance.exercise: Modify network or resource capabilities after approval without changing image.
acceptance.acceptance: Approval becomes invalid and deployment remains blocked.

acceptance.title: Subject lifecycle
acceptance.behaviour: Use immutable subject IDs and explicit tenant memberships.
acceptance.exercise: Rename employee email, merge an alias and provision the same email in another tenant.
acceptance.acceptance: Prior audit identity remains stable and no cross-tenant account takeover occurs.

acceptance.title: Federation security
acceptance.behaviour: Implement qualified OAuth/OIDC flows and issuer/audience checks.
acceptance.exercise: Use wrong audience, stale nonce, reused code and unauthorized redirect URI.
acceptance.acceptance: All invalid flows fail; legitimate authorization-code flow succeeds.

acceptance.title: Downstream offboarding
acceptance.behaviour: Track revocation independently for Git, sessions, private peers and privileged credentials.
acceptance.exercise: Disable an employee while all supported sessions remain open and one provider is unavailable.
acceptance.acceptance: Online revocation meets target; residual provider access is visible and reconciled.

acceptance.title: Policy freshness
acceptance.behaviour: Track effective policy revisions at enforcement points.
acceptance.exercise: Disconnect an access proxy, change policy and advance beyond cache lifetime.
acceptance.acceptance: Configured expiry behavior occurs; no silent indefinite allow remains.

acceptance.title: Emergency access
acceptance.behaviour: Provide protected, audited recovery independent of the failed primary IdP.
acceptance.exercise: Disable IdP and exercise authorized break-glass recovery.
acceptance.acceptance: Access is time-bound, alerted, scoped and cannot become an unlogged standing grant.

acceptance.title: Negative authorization matrix
acceptance.behaviour: Test every API through ordinary roles and service identities.
acceptance.exercise: Call sensitive actions through direct routes, SDK, MCP and alternative aliases.
acceptance.acceptance: No hidden administrator-only test shortcut masks missing checks.

acceptance.title: Repository lifecycle
acceptance.behaviour: Support create, archive, restore, delete-retain and portable export with ownership.
acceptance.exercise: Crash repository provisioning after external creation but before local finalization.
acceptance.acceptance: Retry binds the existing repository and does not create uncontrolled duplicates.

acceptance.title: Ref consistency
acceptance.behaviour: Preserve expected-old-value and protected-reference checks on every Git transport.
acceptance.exercise: Race conflicting pushes through HTTPS and SSH.
acceptance.acceptance: Only valid updates commit; protection cannot be bypassed by transport choice.

acceptance.title: Git storage authority
acceptance.behaviour: Qualify repository storage and failover rather than assume generic S3 filesystem semantics.
acceptance.exercise: Interrupt a repository write-owner during push and attempt a second writer.
acceptance.acceptance: No split-brain ref mutation; acknowledged durability matches declared profile.

acceptance.title: Backup completeness
acceptance.behaviour: Restore repository objects, refs, metadata, LFS and required forge configuration together.
acceptance.exercise: Restore an archived project with pull requests and large files to an isolated forge.
acceptance.acceptance: Integrity checks pass and authorized users can clone the intended history.

acceptance.title: Scoped Git credentials
acceptance.behaviour: Bind PATs, SSH/deploy keys and build tokens to required repositories and actions.
acceptance.exercise: Use a repository read token to enumerate or push another private repository.
acceptance.acceptance: Unapproved operations fail and token expiry/revocation is enforced.

acceptance.title: Server hook restriction
acceptance.behaviour: Disallow tenant executable hooks inside trusted Git service.
acceptance.exercise: Upload a server hook through all supported repository-management paths.
acceptance.acceptance: Hook never runs in the privileged forge; approved jobs use isolated workers.

acceptance.title: Import and mirror egress
acceptance.behaviour: Apply route, redirect, DNS and credential restrictions to imports and mirrors.
acceptance.exercise: Import a repository whose redirect or submodule targets a forbidden internal host.
acceptance.acceptance: No network request reaches the prohibited destination.

acceptance.title: Git resource limits
acceptance.behaviour: Bound pack, object, process, CPU, storage and concurrency consumption.
acceptance.exercise: Submit oversized/deep object graphs and many concurrent clones in an internal test.
acceptance.acceptance: Limits fail explicitly; unrelated tenant service stays available.

acceptance.title: PR approval integrity
acceptance.behaviour: Require protected checks/reviews for the exact candidate source.
acceptance.exercise: Force-push new code after review or alter required-check identity.
acceptance.acceptance: Previous approval cannot authorize the new source.

acceptance.title: LFS access
acceptance.behaviour: Enforce repository authorization for LFS reads, uploads and signed URLs.
acceptance.exercise: Try a known LFS object identifier from another tenant and replay an expired URL.
acceptance.acceptance: No unauthorized access; intended repository access works.

acceptance.title: Forge outage isolation
acceptance.behaviour: Keep existing runtime sites independent of forge availability.
acceptance.exercise: Stop the forge after production deployment.
acceptance.acceptance: Serving continues; new builds fail meaningfully and resume without duplicate releases.

acceptance.title: Repository portability
acceptance.behaviour: Export standard Git and documented review/configuration metadata.
acceptance.exercise: Move an exported project to another supported forge and reconnect deployment source.
acceptance.acceptance: Source history remains usable without a Ferrum-specific Git format.

acceptance.title: Webhook authenticity
acceptance.behaviour: Authenticate, deduplicate and bind source events to approved repositories.
acceptance.exercise: Replay a valid webhook and submit forged or cross-repository delivery identifiers.
acceptance.acceptance: One intent is created; invalid events do not start jobs.

acceptance.title: Exact commit checkout
acceptance.behaviour: Build the recorded immutable commit and record submodule/LFS inputs.
acceptance.exercise: Move the branch after enqueue and before worker checkout.
acceptance.acceptance: Artifact provenance identifies and contains the approved commit, not the new tip.

acceptance.title: Builder sandbox
acceptance.behaviour: Execute repository scripts and dependency hooks in disposable isolated workers.
acceptance.exercise: Controlled job attempts host socket, host filesystem, kernel privilege and cluster API access.
acceptance.acceptance: Attempts are contained and no management credential is exposed.

acceptance.title: Production isolation
acceptance.behaviour: Deny build and preview access to production data, payments and OT routes.
acceptance.exercise: A build attempts to resolve and call all production-bound services.
acceptance.acceptance: No production effect or data read occurs; approved package access still works.

acceptance.title: Secret exposure controls
acceptance.behaviour: Avoid unnecessary build secrets and scope necessary temporary package credentials.
acceptance.exercise: Malicious build encodes or prints a test secret and tries outbound exfiltration.
acceptance.acceptance: No production secrets exist; egress and credential scope contain permitted test-secret exposure.

acceptance.title: Cache trust
acceptance.behaviour: Partition mutable caches by tenant and source trust level.
acceptance.exercise: Untrusted PR seeds a cache consumed by a protected production build.
acceptance.acceptance: Protected build cannot trust the poisoned entry.

acceptance.title: Dependency pinning
acceptance.behaviour: Pin builder images, package locks and executable build dependencies.
acceptance.exercise: A dependency registry changes the version behind an unpinned reference.
acceptance.acceptance: Qualification rejects nondeterministic/unapproved inputs or records an explicit approved exception.

acceptance.title: Artifact finalization
acceptance.behaviour: Publish immutable artifacts only through a trusted finalizer.
acceptance.exercise: Worker uploads one digest then substitutes content before promotion.
acceptance.acceptance: Digest/integrity mismatch blocks publication and deployment.

acceptance.title: Signing authority
acceptance.behaviour: Keep production signing authority outside untrusted build execution.
acceptance.exercise: Build requests signing for an unrelated tenant artifact or arbitrary digest.
acceptance.acceptance: Signer policy denies it and records the attempt.

acceptance.title: Provenance privacy
acceptance.behaviour: Protect private repository and customer metadata in attestations.
acceptance.exercise: Attempt publication of private provenance to a public transparency service.
acceptance.acceptance: Disclosure policy blocks or redacts it; internal verification remains possible.

acceptance.title: Build cancellation
acceptance.behaviour: Cancel sandbox work, revoke temporary identity and clean unused outputs.
acceptance.exercise: Cancel while a worker is uploading or restarting.
acceptance.acceptance: No live credential/job survives outside its documented cancellation envelope.

acceptance.title: Tenant fairness
acceptance.behaviour: Schedule builds under per-tenant concurrency and budget controls.
acceptance.exercise: One tenant floods expensive builds while another starts a small build.
acceptance.acceptance: Fairness target and caps hold; no global starvation.

acceptance.title: Log safety
acceptance.behaviour: Authenticate logs and escape untrusted control content.
acceptance.exercise: View logs containing terminal escapes, HTML and a different tenant job ID.
acceptance.acceptance: No script/control injection or cross-tenant access; authorized troubleshooting remains possible.

acceptance.title: Customer runner trust
acceptance.behaviour: Label customer-runner artifacts with their actual assurance level.
acceptance.exercise: Submit an artifact from a customer runner with fabricated high-assurance provenance.
acceptance.acceptance: Production policy does not grant hosted-builder assurance.

acceptance.title: Environment separation
acceptance.behaviour: Maintain separate identities, bindings and caches per environment.
acceptance.exercise: Copy a production manifest into preview without an approved production binding.
acceptance.acceptance: Preview cannot acquire production capabilities or secrets.

acceptance.title: Release immutability
acceptance.behaviour: Bind release to artifact, config, policy, runtime and resource-schema versions.
acceptance.exercise: Change a mutable image tag after release approval.
acceptance.acceptance: Deployment still uses approved digest or fails trust validation.

acceptance.title: Promotion serialization
acceptance.behaviour: Prevent two promotions from interleaving one environment's route and schema state.
acceptance.exercise: Submit concurrent approved promotions and interrupt one controller.
acceptance.acceptance: One coherent deployment wins; the other conflicts or waits safely.

acceptance.title: Readiness gating
acceptance.behaviour: Route traffic only to verified ready instances.
acceptance.exercise: New release starts a process but cannot access a required resource.
acceptance.acceptance: It receives no production traffic and the previous healthy release remains.

acceptance.title: Migration compatibility
acceptance.behaviour: Use serialized expand/contract migrations and explicit rollback limits.
acceptance.exercise: Fail mid-backfill and attempt rollback to an incompatible old application.
acceptance.acceptance: Migration resumes or recovery is required; no unsafe automatic rollback.

acceptance.title: Preview access
acceptance.behaviour: Protect previews through every hostname and direct origin.
acceptance.exercise: Access preview via unlisted deployment alias without membership.
acceptance.acceptance: All alternate routes deny access.

acceptance.title: Preview cleanup
acceptance.behaviour: Expire previews, credentials and orphan resources without deleting retained artifacts in use.
acceptance.exercise: Crash cleanup between route removal and resource detachment.
acceptance.acceptance: Reconciliation finishes cleanup idempotently and preserves shared dependencies.

acceptance.title: Graceful rollout
acceptance.behaviour: Drain requests and handle long-lived connections under bounded policy.
acceptance.exercise: Roll out while uploads, streaming and websocket clients are active.
acceptance.acceptance: Declared drain/reconnect behavior occurs without false operation completion.

acceptance.title: Rollback correctness
acceptance.behaviour: Rollback selects a coherent compatible release, not only an old image.
acceptance.exercise: Restore previous image with changed schema and credentials.
acceptance.acceptance: Policy checks compatibility or requires forward recovery.

acceptance.title: Durable background work
acceptance.behaviour: Put long-running effects in managed jobs rather than untracked SSR tasks.
acceptance.exercise: Terminate SSR process after accepting a background request.
acceptance.acceptance: Durable job remains visible and completes/reconciles once.

acceptance.title: Scheduler semantics
acceptance.behaviour: Define timezone, DST, missed-run and overlap behavior for schedules.
acceptance.exercise: Run schedules across DST change, outage and overlapping duration.
acceptance.acceptance: Documented runs occur without unplanned duplicates or lost work.

acceptance.title: Capability reconsent
acceptance.behaviour: Require renewed consent for runtime/network/resource permission expansion.
acceptance.exercise: A source change adds unrestricted egress and production database access.
acceptance.acceptance: Deployment cannot inherit privileges from prior approval.

acceptance.title: Serving independence
acceptance.behaviour: Keep deployed site serving when management and build systems are unavailable.
acceptance.exercise: Stop management APIs and builders while current release is healthy.
acceptance.acceptance: Serving remains within documented policy/key-cache envelopes.

acceptance.title: Public/private cache separation
acceptance.behaviour: Never place personalized responses in public shared cache by default.
acceptance.exercise: Two users and tenants request same URL after one authenticated response is cached.
acceptance.acceptance: No account, token or private content crosses users or tenants.

acceptance.title: Framework conformance
acceptance.behaviour: Qualify each framework/runtime combination across supported features.
acceptance.exercise: Run SSR, static, streaming, actions, images and revalidation on multiple replicas.
acceptance.acceptance: Support matrix matches actual behavior; unsupported features fail clearly.

acceptance.title: Deployment skew
acceptance.behaviour: Retain old assets and coordinate framework deployment-sensitive state.
acceptance.exercise: Keep old browser sessions active during rollout and rollback.
acceptance.acceptance: No unauthorized or duplicate mutation and no unexplained old-asset failure.

acceptance.title: Browser origin isolation
acceptance.behaviour: Separate untrusted content from management origin and control cookies.
acceptance.exercise: Customer page attempts parent-domain cookie and management service-worker interaction.
acceptance.acceptance: Management session remains unaffected and customer isolation policy holds.

acceptance.title: Domain ownership
acceptance.behaviour: Verify normalized domain ownership and uniqueness before routing.
acceptance.exercise: Two tenants claim case/IDNA/trailing-dot equivalents or overlapping wildcard.
acceptance.acceptance: Only authorized unique binding can activate.

acceptance.title: Origin bypass
acceptance.behaviour: Apply access policy to all ingress paths and reject unknown hosts.
acceptance.exercise: Call private site through IP, service hostname, old preview URL and forged identity headers.
acceptance.acceptance: No path bypasses access enforcement.

acceptance.title: Certificate lifecycle
acceptance.behaviour: Handle issuance, rate limits, renewal and transfer with scoped provider credentials.
acceptance.exercise: Fail renewal or transfer ownership while old DNS remains.
acceptance.acceptance: Alerts and safe routing state occur; stale claim cannot be hijacked.

acceptance.title: Image and fetch SSRF
acceptance.behaviour: Enforce destination policy on image optimization and server-side URL fetches.
acceptance.exercise: Allowed hostname redirects or resolves to a prohibited address including IPv6.
acceptance.acceptance: Connection is blocked before data access.

acceptance.title: Request resource budgets
acceptance.behaviour: Bound uploads, headers, decompression and runtime concurrency.
acceptance.exercise: Send large or expensive requests while other tenants operate.
acceptance.acceptance: Clear limit errors and no cross-tenant resource starvation.

acceptance.title: Upload finalization
acceptance.behaviour: Scan and verify objects before making them application-visible.
acceptance.exercise: Crash between object upload and metadata commit and repeat finalization.
acceptance.acceptance: No partial object is served; orphans are reconciled and retries are safe.

acceptance.title: Storefront authority
acceptance.behaviour: Keep pricing, tax, stock, customer ownership and payment state in backend actions.
acceptance.exercise: Modify browser totals, customer ID and payment success flags.
acceptance.acceptance: Backend rejects tampering and recalculates authoritative results.

acceptance.title: Headless content lifecycle
acceptance.behaviour: Provide drafts, revision, locale and approved publishing semantics.
acceptance.exercise: Publish stale content revision or reuse a preview credential after expiry.
acceptance.acceptance: Version/access checks prevent unintended publication or disclosure.

acceptance.title: Logical resource binding
acceptance.behaviour: Separate declared capability from provider instance and workload binding.
acceptance.exercise: Install same app in cloud and customer-owned resource profiles.
acceptance.acceptance: Business code uses stable logical binding without obtaining provider administration.

acceptance.title: Idempotent provisioning
acceptance.behaviour: Reconcile ambiguous provider creation before retrying.
acceptance.exercise: Provider creates database but response is lost and controller restarts.
acceptance.acceptance: Existing owned resource is discovered; no uncontrolled duplicate is billed.

acceptance.title: Required resource readiness
acceptance.behaviour: Do not activate an app before required resources and migrations verify.
acceptance.exercise: Provider reports accepted while actual database is unavailable.
acceptance.acceptance: App remains pending/degraded rather than falsely ready.

acceptance.title: Tenant database isolation
acceptance.behaviour: Enforce tenant scope beyond query parameterization.
acceptance.exercise: Run raw/invalid queries under another tenant role and reuse pooled connections.
acceptance.acceptance: No cross-tenant rows or leaked session context.

acceptance.title: Scoped credentials
acceptance.behaviour: Separate runtime and migrator roles and rotate bindings safely.
acceptance.exercise: Runtime tries DDL/admin actions; old credential is used after rotation.
acceptance.acceptance: Unauthorized schema operations fail and retirement follows declared rotation policy.

acceptance.title: Resource migration
acceptance.behaviour: Serialize checksum-versioned migrations with bounded locks and resumable backfill.
acceptance.exercise: Kill migration between batches then start another replica.
acceptance.acceptance: One migration owner resumes without duplicate transformations.

acceptance.title: Provider capability mismatch
acceptance.behaviour: Reject required semantics unavailable from selected backend.
acceptance.exercise: Bind a nontransactional or incompatible backend to a transactional capability.
acceptance.acceptance: Install fails explicitly rather than silently weakening guarantees.

acceptance.title: Data authority classification
acceptance.behaviour: Identify primary, derived, archival and disposable datasets.
acceptance.exercise: Delete an index and separately corrupt primary transaction evidence in tests.
acceptance.acceptance: Index rebuild is supported; primary corruption triggers recovery rather than silent regeneration.

acceptance.title: Object consistency
acceptance.behaviour: Reconcile object metadata and bytes without claiming distributed ACID.
acceptance.exercise: Fail database commit after object upload and fail object delete after metadata change.
acceptance.acceptance: Orphans/deletions are tracked and retried with authorization.

acceptance.title: Backup semantics
acceptance.behaviour: Record resource backups, keys and logical consistency points.
acceptance.exercise: Restore multiple resources from incompatible timestamps.
acceptance.acceptance: Validation detects inconsistency before application or external effects activate.

acceptance.title: Customer resource detachment
acceptance.behaviour: Retain customer-owned resources on uninstall unless explicit authority says otherwise.
acceptance.exercise: Uninstall app bound to an externally owned bucket/database.
acceptance.acceptance: Binding is revoked; external service and unrelated data are not destroyed.

acceptance.title: Destructive deletion controls
acceptance.behaviour: Check retention, legal hold and dependencies before destruction.
acceptance.exercise: Delete a resource still referenced by another deployment or under hold.
acceptance.acceptance: Deletion is blocked with an explainable reason.

acceptance.title: Query console safety
acceptance.behaviour: Use scoped short-lived access and read-only defaults for administrative queries.
acceptance.exercise: Resource operator attempts core ledger mutation and oversized data extraction.
acceptance.acceptance: Business-invariant bypass and unapproved export are denied.

acceptance.title: Licensing gate
acceptance.behaviour: Approve exact engine edition/feature/hosting rights before managed distribution.
acceptance.exercise: Select restricted Timescale functionality for arbitrary customer DB hosting.
acceptance.acceptance: Provisioning is blocked pending approved terms or qualified alternative.

acceptance.title: Resource portability
acceptance.behaviour: Provide export formats and restore path per resource class.
acceptance.exercise: Export app data, objects and schema then restore to another qualified provider.
acceptance.acceptance: Integrity and app-level invariants verify; unsupported differences are explicit.

acceptance.title: Single scaler owner
acceptance.behaviour: Use one authoritative controller per scaling target.
acceptance.exercise: HPA and resource reconciler attempt conflicting replica changes.
acceptance.acceptance: Configuration rejects competing ownership or integrates them under one policy.

acceptance.title: Connection budgeting
acceptance.behaviour: Account for API, worker, plugin, listener and migration connections.
acceptance.exercise: Scale API and workers to maximum while starting migration.
acceptance.acceptance: Configured reserve remains and admission prevents database exhaustion.

acceptance.title: Stateful scaling
acceptance.behaviour: Use engine-specific scaling with replication and migration guards.
acceptance.exercise: Request database replica growth or storage resize during impaired replication.
acceptance.acceptance: Unsafe changes wait or fail explicitly; read replicas are not advertised as write sharding.

acceptance.title: Budget enforcement
acceptance.behaviour: Separate alerts, estimates and enforced admission caps.
acceptance.exercise: Generate burst build/runtime usage beyond budget.
acceptance.acceptance: New spend is bounded under policy and unavoidable delayed charges are visible.

acceptance.title: Critical reserve
acceptance.behaviour: Protect durable command/evidence capacity before shedding telemetry.
acceptance.exercise: Fill edge/storage budget with samples while a critical command finishes.
acceptance.acceptance: Only eligible data is shed; critical evidence is retained or new work stops safely.

acceptance.title: Gateway drain
acceptance.behaviour: Scale connection services using ownership-aware drain.
acceptance.exercise: Scale in a gateway holding many active sockets and ambiguous commands.
acceptance.acceptance: Controlled reconnection/reconciliation occurs without blind redispatch.

acceptance.title: Noisy neighbor
acceptance.behaviour: Maintain per-tenant fairness and shared-resource quotas.
acceptance.exercise: One tenant saturates query/ingest/build capacity.
acceptance.acceptance: Other tenants retain declared service envelope and throttling is attributable.

acceptance.title: Capacity evidence
acceptance.behaviour: Attach profile limits to measured artifacts and hardware.
acceptance.exercise: Run sustained growth and recovery-drain tests, not only a short throughput burst.
acceptance.acceptance: Published limits reflect p95/p99, backlog, growth, errors and cost evidence.

acceptance.title: Reachability versus rights
acceptance.behaviour: Require application authorization even over a private tunnel.
acceptance.exercise: Connected employee requests payroll without payroll role.
acceptance.acceptance: Network succeeds if allowed but business access is denied.

acceptance.title: Provider administration isolation
acceptance.behaviour: Separate tenant network/proxy administration scopes.
acceptance.exercise: Tenant network admin tries to inspect or modify another tenant routes.
acceptance.acceptance: Provider boundary and Ferrum APIs both prevent it.

acceptance.title: Posture trust
acceptance.behaviour: Use qualified fresh device evidence rather than asset metadata alone.
acceptance.exercise: Device reports stale or spoofed compliance data.
acceptance.acceptance: Policy treats it as stale/untrusted and follows declared access rule.

acceptance.title: Private connectors
acceptance.behaviour: Expose only approved resources through outbound-authenticated connectors.
acceptance.exercise: Compromised connector attempts arbitrary management or other-tenant destinations.
acceptance.acceptance: Routes and service authorization prevent lateral access.

acceptance.title: Overlapping addresses
acceptance.behaviour: Isolate customers using identical private CIDRs.
acceptance.exercise: Two customers expose the same IP and port through separate connectors.
acceptance.acceptance: Routing uses customer identity/binding and never crosses destinations.

acceptance.title: Revocation coverage
acceptance.behaviour: Revoke web, Git, tunnel and privileged sessions with per-provider completion.
acceptance.exercise: Offboard user with active sessions and one unreachable enforcement point.
acceptance.acceptance: Residual access is visible and expiry/reconciliation follow policy.

acceptance.title: Privileged session scope
acceptance.behaviour: Use target/action-scoped temporary grants for administration.
acceptance.exercise: Approved database diagnostic session attempts shell or another database.
acceptance.acceptance: Grant cannot exceed its target/actions and expires as scheduled.

acceptance.title: Header spoofing
acceptance.behaviour: Accept identity assertions only from authenticated trusted proxies.
acceptance.exercise: Public client injects identity headers and alternate forwarding chains.
acceptance.acceptance: Claims are stripped/rejected and tenant scope is not changed.

acceptance.title: Access outage policy
acceptance.behaviour: Define cache expiry and fail behavior per resource risk.
acceptance.exercise: Lose policy service and continue requests past allowed cache age.
acceptance.acceptance: No undocumented fail-open path; emergency recovery is separate.

acceptance.title: OT access boundary
acceptance.behaviour: Keep industrial support separate from ordinary employee connectivity.
acceptance.exercise: Employee VPN peer attempts direct PLC or safety-network access.
acceptance.acceptance: Denied unless separately authorized site-specific support path exists.

acceptance.title: Secret indirection
acceptance.behaviour: Store references and lease metadata rather than plaintext in app config.
acceptance.exercise: Read application configuration, exports, logs and error reports.
acceptance.acceptance: No secret value or broad DSN appears in ordinary reads.

acceptance.title: Workload attestation
acceptance.behaviour: Issue service identity only to the approved deployment/job context.
acceptance.exercise: Untrusted build impersonates runtime or platform workload identity.
acceptance.acceptance: Identity issuer rejects mismatched attestation/binding.

acceptance.title: Root rotation
acceptance.behaviour: Rotate signing/trust roots with staged verification and compromise handling.
acceptance.exercise: Retire one root while workloads still use an old bundle.
acceptance.acceptance: Declared overlap works; revoked root cannot authorize new artifacts.

acceptance.title: Key recovery
acceptance.behaviour: Maintain a protected independent recovery procedure for encrypted backups.
acceptance.exercise: Primary secrets service/database is unavailable during recovery drill.
acceptance.acceptance: Authorized recovery can restore keys without public disclosure or circular dependency.

acceptance.title: Credential expiry
acceptance.behaviour: Define online/offline behavior for expired credentials and trust bundles.
acceptance.exercise: Gateway or access point remains offline past validity.
acceptance.acceptance: No insecure verification bypass; allowed degraded behavior is explicit.

acceptance.title: Environment secret scope
acceptance.behaviour: Prevent production secret copying into previews and public build variables.
acceptance.exercise: Developer attempts to expose backend secret through public env prefix.
acceptance.acceptance: Admission blocks the binding or clearly classifies intended public values.

acceptance.title: Compromise response
acceptance.behaviour: Revoke affected identities and reconcile deployments after key compromise.
acceptance.exercise: Simulate compromised publisher/workload key and attempt new operations.
acceptance.acceptance: Trust update blocks misuse, affected inventory is visible, evidence is retained.

acceptance.title: Operator visibility honesty
acceptance.behaviour: Describe hosting/key access accurately.
acceptance.exercise: Review a customer-managed-key profile where operator runs plaintext workload.
acceptance.acceptance: Documentation does not falsely claim operator blindness.

acceptance.title: Transactional outbox
acceptance.behaviour: Commit authoritative state and outbox together.
acceptance.exercise: Crash before commit, after commit and after publication.
acceptance.acceptance: No committed event is silently lost; duplicates are handled.

acceptance.title: Consumer idempotency
acceptance.behaviour: Apply inbox receipt and local business effect atomically where possible.
acceptance.exercise: Deliver same event concurrently and after worker restart.
acceptance.acceptance: One logical local effect occurs with auditable duplicate handling.

acceptance.title: External ambiguity
acceptance.behaviour: Reconcile nontransactional effects before retrying uncertain outcomes.
acceptance.exercise: Provider performs action but response disappears.
acceptance.acceptance: State becomes unknown/reconcilable, not automatic success or blind retry.

acceptance.title: Lease fencing
acceptance.behaviour: Prevent stale workers from committing or dispatching beyond ownership.
acceptance.exercise: Expire lease and resume old worker after a new claimant starts.
acceptance.acceptance: Stale effect is rejected at enforceable boundary.

acceptance.title: Notification recovery
acceptance.behaviour: Use notification as hint with durable polling/replay fallback.
acceptance.exercise: Drop all NOTIFY/live messages while committing work.
acceptance.acceptance: Consumers recover from durable state without lost tasks.

acceptance.title: Cursor correctness
acceptance.behaviour: Use committed gap-safe event cursors rather than raw uncommitted sequence assumptions.
acceptance.exercise: Allocate low event ID in slow transaction and commit higher ID first.
acceptance.acceptance: Subscriber eventually observes both or performs valid reconciliation.

acceptance.title: Snapshot subscription
acceptance.behaviour: Avoid race between snapshot and live subscription.
acceptance.exercise: Commit update exactly between snapshot read and listener attach.
acceptance.acceptance: Update is delivered or snapshot replay catches it.

acceptance.title: Contract evolution
acceptance.behaviour: Version events/actions and reject unsupported mandatory semantics.
acceptance.exercise: Old consumer receives new optional and incompatible required fields.
acceptance.acceptance: Compatible change works; incompatible use fails explicitly.

acceptance.title: Regional authority
acceptance.behaviour: Use one write authority or qualified conflict protocol for critical resources.
acceptance.exercise: Partition regions and attempt command/billing writes from both.
acceptance.acceptance: No independent dual authority or duplicate effect.

acceptance.title: Service delegation
acceptance.behaviour: Validate workload plus tenant/user context downstream.
acceptance.exercise: Authorized service forwards forged tenant or overbroad delegated token.
acceptance.acceptance: Receiver rejects unauthorized action and records correlation.

acceptance.title: Any-replica intake
acceptance.behaviour: Persist request before acknowledging and expose stable status ID.
acceptance.exercise: Request hits API 1, client reconnects through API 2 after response loss.
acceptance.acceptance: Same authorized intent/result is retrievable without server affinity.

acceptance.title: Exact connection owner
acceptance.behaviour: Route device work only to current authenticated owner/generation.
acceptance.exercise: Charger is on gateway 3 while random worker 1 receives wakeup.
acceptance.acceptance: Only eligible owner sends; nonowner cannot falsely acknowledge execution.

acceptance.title: Reconnect generation
acceptance.behaviour: Protect new connection from old disconnect and stale sender.
acceptance.exercise: Reconnect station to gateway 4 then close old gateway 3 connection.
acceptance.acceptance: New mapping remains; old connection cannot dispatch new work.

acceptance.title: Physical intent deduplication
acceptance.behaviour: Scope idempotency to business intent and reject payload mismatch.
acceptance.exercise: Repeat start concurrently with same key, then with changed payload.
acceptance.acceptance: One intent exists; mismatch returns conflict.

acceptance.title: Final deadline gate
acceptance.behaviour: Recheck deadline and authority immediately before external send.
acceptance.exercise: Queue commands behind slow operation until later command expires.
acceptance.acceptance: Expired command is not sent or granted a renewed artificial lifetime.

acceptance.title: Clock correctness
acceptance.behaviour: Do not extend authorization through backward wall-clock changes.
acceptance.exercise: Jump clock backward, reboot offline and suspend/resume near expiry.
acceptance.acceptance: Lease/command remains within declared trust envelope or dispatch stops for uncertainty.

acceptance.title: Recovery target binding
acceptance.behaviour: Persist exact target/adapter/configuration binding for recovery.
acceptance.exercise: Two devices share operation; crash after dispatch to A.
acceptance.acceptance: Recovery queries A only and never treats B response as evidence about A.

acceptance.title: Inbound durability
acceptance.behaviour: Persist critical protocol evidence/response identity before durable acknowledgment.
acceptance.exercise: Crash after receipt before journal commit and retry device frame.
acceptance.acceptance: No acknowledged billing event is silently lost within stated storage fault model.

acceptance.title: Protocol versus business outcome
acceptance.behaviour: Distinguish request acceptance, session creation and charging evidence.
acceptance.exercise: Charger accepts start but never begins energy flow.
acceptance.acceptance: UI and billing do not report active charging or settlement without evidence.

acceptance.title: Durable correlation
acceptance.behaviour: Persist protocol IDs, station/EVSE/connector and transaction mapping.
acceptance.exercise: Restart gateway and replay transaction frames across connections.
acceptance.acceptance: IDs and events remain correctly associated without process-counter collision.

acceptance.title: Safe unknown outcome
acceptance.behaviour: Never infer failure from timeout after possible execution.
acceptance.exercise: Crash after socket send and before response recording.
acceptance.acceptance: Outcome remains unknown until equipment/operator evidence resolves it.

acceptance.title: Meter evidence
acceptance.behaviour: Preserve units, multiplier, quality and target dimensions needed for billing.
acceptance.exercise: Send reset, late, missing, alternate-unit and unverified signed meter data.
acceptance.acceptance: Billing uses approved evidence policy; unsupported interpretation is flagged.

acceptance.title: Critical quota behavior
acceptance.behaviour: Keep stop/report/reconciliation paths independent of optional usage caps.
acceptance.exercise: Exhaust telemetry or account quota during charging session.
acceptance.acceptance: Critical operational reporting and permitted stop requests continue.

acceptance.title: Client replay
acceptance.behaviour: Recover live status after dropped notifications and cursor expiry.
acceptance.exercise: Disconnect browser through command completion then reconnect on another API.
acceptance.acceptance: Authoritative state/replay is correct; expired cursor requests resync.

acceptance.title: Execution trust classes
acceptance.behaviour: Distinguish meta, WASM, native and isolated service extensions.
acceptance.exercise: Install unreviewed native code through an ordinary customer package.
acceptance.acceptance: It cannot enter the trusted process or be mislabeled sandboxed.

acceptance.title: Manifest versioning
acceptance.behaviour: Reject unknown or unsupported required fields in package contracts.
acceptance.exercise: Submit new service/resource fields to an older runtime.
acceptance.acceptance: Clear compatibility error; no ignored security requirement.

acceptance.title: Capability consent
acceptance.behaviour: Display and approve new permissions/resources/network cost at install and upgrade.
acceptance.exercise: Upgrade changes scope without changing UI bundle.
acceptance.acceptance: Fresh consent is required before activation.

acceptance.title: Host resource scoping
acceptance.behaviour: Derive tenant/application scope for WASM resource handles from host context.
acceptance.exercise: Plugin supplies another tenant ID or reuses foreign resource handle.
acceptance.acceptance: Host denies cross-scope operation and retains audit evidence.

acceptance.title: UI isolation
acceptance.behaviour: Keep arbitrary extension UI from general shell sessions.
acceptance.exercise: Untrusted iframe sends forged cross-origin message or requests admin token.
acceptance.acceptance: Exact-origin/method/capability bridge rejects it.

acceptance.title: Dependency safety
acceptance.behaviour: Review transitive extensions and privileges.
acceptance.exercise: App update adds a privileged dependency through nested package reference.
acceptance.acceptance: Plan surfaces the new trust/cost boundary and requires authorization.

acceptance.title: Lifecycle cleanup
acceptance.behaviour: Revoke bindings and retain data correctly when disabling/uninstalling.
acceptance.exercise: Disable compromised extension while jobs and shared resources exist.
acceptance.acceptance: New access stops; critical workflows fail explicitly and retained data is preserved.

acceptance.title: Certification scope
acceptance.behaviour: Tie labels to artifact, capabilities, provider profile and evidence.
acceptance.exercise: Update certified connector binary without equivalent tests.
acceptance.acceptance: Old label does not automatically apply to new artifact.

acceptance.title: Deprecation migration
acceptance.behaviour: Provide supported migration/export for retired extension.
acceptance.exercise: Remove vendor support while customers depend on connector.
acceptance.acceptance: Users see limits and replacement path; marketplace does not imply indefinite support.

acceptance.title: Core invariants
acceptance.behaviour: Prevent configurable scripts/workflows from overriding shared business invariants.
acceptance.exercise: Custom workflow tries to bypass stock hold, ledger posting or permission checks.
acceptance.acceptance: Invariant holds regardless of extension logic.

acceptance.title: Agent capability boundary
acceptance.behaviour: Constrain AI tools independently of natural-language output.
acceptance.exercise: Prompt injection in repository/log requests credentials or infrastructure changes.
acceptance.acceptance: Tool authorization remains unchanged and denies privilege escalation.

acceptance.title: Model/provider policy
acceptance.behaviour: Bind model features to approved region, data handling and cost.
acceptance.exercise: User selects unapproved external model for sensitive source/logs.
acceptance.acceptance: Data transfer is blocked or requires explicit approved policy change.

acceptance.title: Approval integrity
acceptance.behaviour: Bind approved AI action plan and prohibit self-approval.
acceptance.exercise: Agent edits target/payload after human approval.
acceptance.acceptance: Changed action requires new authorization.

acceptance.title: Development sandbox
acceptance.behaviour: Default local AI/developer clients to synthetic sandbox resources.
acceptance.exercise: Starter attempts production token or real payment use.
acceptance.acceptance: No production effect is possible under default development binding.

acceptance.title: Budget and cancellation
acceptance.behaviour: Bound model/tool calls, concurrency and repeated attempts.
acceptance.exercise: Agent loops tools or retries an expensive inference failure.
acceptance.acceptance: Budgets stop new work and show actual/estimated cost.

acceptance.title: Evidence and abstention
acceptance.behaviour: Require freshness/provenance and explicit unknown results.
acceptance.exercise: Model invents resource IDs or relies on stale operational state.
acceptance.acceptance: Deterministic validation rejects action and surfaces uncertainty.

acceptance.title: Data boundary disclosure
acceptance.behaviour: Describe remote processing accurately for local AI tools.
acceptance.exercise: Review client that executes locally but calls hosted inference.
acceptance.acceptance: UI/docs do not claim all data stays on device.

acceptance.title: Operational autonomy
acceptance.behaviour: Keep safety control outside ordinary AI automation.
acceptance.exercise: AI requests raw PLC write or safety override.
acceptance.acceptance: No tool/capability path grants it; specialist boundary remains intact.

acceptance.title: Consistent scope UI
acceptance.behaviour: Show tenant, project, environment and production context on management actions.
acceptance.exercise: Switch customer/environment during an open action dialog.
acceptance.acceptance: Action remains bound to original verified scope or requires reconfirmation.

acceptance.title: Asynchronous UX
acceptance.behaviour: Preserve operation status across refresh and browser reconnect.
acceptance.exercise: Start resource provision, reload and reopen from another session.
acceptance.acceptance: Progress, failure and safe retry remain visible by operation ID.

acceptance.title: Accessible administration
acceptance.behaviour: Meet declared WCAG 2.2 AA target with automated and manual checks.
acceptance.exercise: Navigate main workflows by keyboard/screen reader and test focus/errors.
acceptance.acceptance: No critical action is inaccessible; evidence distinguishes automated/manual review.

acceptance.title: Localization correctness
acceptance.behaviour: Separate translated display from exact stored/API values.
acceptance.exercise: Use different locales, RTL, decimal formats and timezones.
acceptance.acceptance: Amounts, dates and action semantics remain correct.

acceptance.title: Permission explanation
acceptance.behaviour: Explain denied/disabled actions without hidden-resource leakage.
acceptance.exercise: User lacks one capability and opens deploy/resource screen.
acceptance.acceptance: Reason and remediation are clear without exposing other tenant objects.

acceptance.title: Operator recovery UX
acceptance.behaviour: Provide meaningful uncertain/partial states and authorized recovery.
acceptance.exercise: Simulate failed rollout, unknown command and provider drift.
acceptance.acceptance: UI does not collapse these to green success or generic retry.

acceptance.title: Bundle provenance
acceptance.behaviour: Build and verify distributed UI from intended source revision.
acceptance.exercise: Update shared frontend without rebuilding committed app dist.
acceptance.acceptance: Release evidence detects stale bundles.

acceptance.title: Audit visibility
acceptance.behaviour: Make approvals, support and policy changes inspectable by customer.
acceptance.exercise: Customer reviews a partner support session and deployment change.
acceptance.acceptance: Relevant actor, scope, reason, expiry and outcomes are visible.

acceptance.title: Telemetry correlation
acceptance.behaviour: Correlate build, release, resource and command paths without logging secrets.
acceptance.exercise: Trace a failed cross-service operation end to end.
acceptance.acceptance: Operator can locate ownership/failure using safe IDs and timestamps.

acceptance.title: Tenant telemetry isolation
acceptance.behaviour: Authorize log/trace queries beyond user-supplied label filters.
acceptance.exercise: Tenant A submits query for tenant B identifiers.
acceptance.acceptance: Backend denies cross-tenant observability data.

acceptance.title: Bounded cardinality
acceptance.behaviour: Bound metric dimensions and handle high-volume detail separately.
acceptance.exercise: Generate many unique user/device values.
acceptance.acceptance: Monitoring remains stable without uncontrolled series growth.

acceptance.title: Operational alert coverage
acceptance.behaviour: Alert on drift, backlog, unknown outcomes, expiry and backup age.
acceptance.exercise: Inject each critical condition.
acceptance.acceptance: Alerts reach owner with relevant runbook and avoid duplicate storm.

acceptance.title: Metering idempotency
acceptance.behaviour: Deduplicate usage and retain price-plan version for invoices.
acceptance.exercise: Replay and reorder usage events, then correct a past quantity.
acceptance.acceptance: Billable totals remain explainable and corrections are auditable.

acceptance.title: Money precision
acceptance.behaviour: Use exact money/quantity calculations for billing.
acceptance.exercise: Accumulate many fractional usage charges and refunds across currencies.
acceptance.acceptance: No floating-point drift; rounding and currency policy are explicit.

acceptance.title: Budget transparency
acceptance.behaviour: Distinguish forecast, alert and enforced cap.
acceptance.exercise: Provider usage arrives late after an alert.
acceptance.acceptance: UI explains estimates/finalization and configured hard admission behavior.

acceptance.title: Incident process
acceptance.behaviour: Maintain severity, communications, evidence and postmortem workflow.
acceptance.exercise: Run tenant leak/key compromise tabletop and controlled dependency outage.
acceptance.acceptance: Roles, escalation, containment and customer communication are exercised.

acceptance.title: Abuse controls
acceptance.behaviour: Manage phishing, crypto-mining, spam and uncontrolled public hosting.
acceptance.exercise: Internal test tenant violates allowed-use resource/egress policy.
acceptance.acceptance: Detection, containment, appeal and evidence operate without harming unrelated tenants.

acceptance.title: Tenant lifecycle
acceptance.behaviour: Implement signup/provision/plan/grace/restrict/close/retain/delete as auditable workflows.
acceptance.exercise: Interrupt provisioning and account closure at each external boundary.
acceptance.acceptance: State reconciles without duplicate resources or accidental data destruction.

acceptance.title: Official partner scope
