acceptance.behaviour: Implement Cloud partner program without removing open-source rights.
acceptance.exercise: Apply partner eligibility restriction to program features and review self-host export.
acceptance.acceptance: Commercial scope is clear; software/license rights are not misrepresented.

acceptance.title: Support least privilege
acceptance.behaviour: Grant named, expiring customer-approved support capabilities.
acceptance.exercise: Partner attempts secret/business access with health-only grant.
acceptance.acceptance: Denied and audited through all API and alternate paths.

acceptance.title: No standing partner admin
acceptance.behaviour: Prevent partner status from granting hidden superuser access.
acceptance.exercise: Add verified partner account without customer grant.
acceptance.acceptance: No customer data/network access is gained.

acceptance.title: Support revocation
acceptance.behaviour: Terminate support access and track active sessions.
acceptance.exercise: Customer revokes grant during diagnostic operation.
acceptance.acceptance: New access stops within declared bound and surviving effects are visible.

acceptance.title: Residency coverage
acceptance.behaviour: Apply region policy to logs, backups, builds, caches and AI as well as database.
acceptance.exercise: Request cross-region artifact copy or external diagnostics export.
acceptance.acceptance: Policy prevents unapproved transfer.

acceptance.title: Account restriction safety
acceptance.behaviour: Preserve export and required operational recovery under billing restriction.
acceptance.exercise: Restrict tenant with retained files and active connected operation.
acceptance.acceptance: No data deletion or unsafe stop/report outage follows merely from billing state.

acceptance.title: Customer controlled profile
acceptance.behaviour: Define operator permissions and local dependency envelope for customer VPC.
acceptance.exercise: Disconnect customer environment from management internet.
acceptance.acceptance: Promised functions continue or fail as documented; no hidden provider license dependency.

acceptance.title: Service ownership
acceptance.behaviour: Assign maintainer, support period and escalation per marketed service.
acceptance.exercise: Provider deprecates an API used by a solution package.
acceptance.acceptance: Affected inventory and migration plan are generated and customers informed.

acceptance.title: Complete backups
acceptance.behaviour: Include authoritative databases, repositories, objects, keys and binding/config evidence.
acceptance.exercise: Restore a full customer profile to an isolated environment.
acceptance.acceptance: All required state is recoverable and linked objects/refs verify.

acceptance.title: Restore isolation
acceptance.behaviour: Disable external effects until reconciliation after restore.
acceptance.exercise: Restore snapshot containing old payment/charging/deployment jobs.
acceptance.acceptance: Nothing re-executes merely because old records reappear.

acceptance.title: Tenant-level recovery
acceptance.behaviour: Use an isolated recovery extraction path for shared-database PITR.
acceptance.exercise: Restore only one tenant with linked resources while others stay current.
acceptance.acceptance: No other tenant is rolled back and restored references remain consistent.

acceptance.title: Key recovery test
acceptance.behaviour: Verify protected recovery of keys required by encrypted backups.
acceptance.exercise: Remove access to primary KMS path during approved recovery drill.
acceptance.acceptance: Recovery works through authorized alternate process without plaintext leakage.

acceptance.title: Failover fencing
acceptance.behaviour: Fence old writers before promoting new regional owners.
acceptance.exercise: Network partition leaves old region alive while recovery starts.
acceptance.acceptance: Only one eligible write/dispatch authority exists or operations stop safely.

acceptance.title: Object and Git integrity
acceptance.behaviour: Verify checksums, ref/object reachability and LFS linkage after recovery.
acceptance.exercise: Corrupt backup object and omit an LFS file.
acceptance.acceptance: Restore validation fails before customer claims are made.

acceptance.title: Capacity recovery
acceptance.behaviour: Control backlog replay and reconnect storms after outage.
acceptance.exercise: Restore platform after large queued workload and device reconnect burst.
acceptance.acceptance: Rate limits preserve critical work and recovery completes within profile targets.

acceptance.title: Update trust
acceptance.behaviour: Validate signed metadata, artifact identity, expiry and rollback protections.
acceptance.exercise: Serve stale or mismatched signed release metadata in a controlled test.
acceptance.acceptance: Updater rejects invalid release path and preserves recoverable current version.

acceptance.title: Runbook exercise
acceptance.behaviour: Exercise clean install, upgrade, rotation, restore, export and vendor retirement.
acceptance.exercise: Operator follows documentation on clean host without developer shortcuts.
acceptance.acceptance: Runbook succeeds or records precise gaps; no undocumented credentials/steps.

acceptance.title: RPO RTO evidence
acceptance.behaviour: Measure recovery objectives under declared fault model.
acceptance.exercise: Run zone/database/provider outage with timestamped committed inputs.
acceptance.acceptance: Published recovery figures match measured loss/time and exclusions.

acceptance.title: Requirement traceability
acceptance.behaviour: Map each supported claim to exact test/evidence and release profile.
acceptance.exercise: Remove evidence from a claimed completed requirement.
acceptance.acceptance: Release gate fails or downgrades claim visibly.

acceptance.title: Security baseline
acceptance.behaviour: Pin applicable ASVS/SSDF controls and record exceptions.
acceptance.exercise: Review web/API/supply-chain controls for release.
acceptance.acceptance: No checklist-only certification claim; unresolved critical controls block profile.

acceptance.title: Independent review
acceptance.behaviour: Require external assurance where the sold profile demands it.
acceptance.exercise: Only internal AI-generated review exists for independent-review requirement.
acceptance.acceptance: Gate remains externally blocked, not auto-complete.

acceptance.title: Provider qualification
acceptance.behaviour: Test real provider sandbox/tenant for claimed integrations.
acceptance.exercise: Mock-only adapter is selected as production-qualified.
acceptance.acceptance: Label and admission reject unsupported claim.

acceptance.title: Hardware qualification
acceptance.behaviour: Tie device support to model, firmware, protocol and site evidence.
acceptance.exercise: Software simulator passes but physical device was never connected.
acceptance.acceptance: Device is not labeled hardware-qualified.

acceptance.title: Golden journeys
acceptance.behaviour: Execute all applicable documented end-to-end journeys against release artifacts.
acceptance.exercise: Run storefront, access, resources, routing, restore and partner journeys.
acceptance.acceptance: Failures/skips remain visible and mandatory failures block release.

acceptance.title: Mutation and fault coverage
acceptance.behaviour: Test invariants under deliberate internal faults and logic mutations.
acceptance.exercise: Disable a key check or crash at a persistence boundary.
acceptance.acceptance: Relevant test fails; surviving mutations trigger test improvement.

acceptance.title: Release evidence integrity
acceptance.behaviour: Generate and protect source, pin, artifact, test and approval evidence.
acceptance.exercise: Alter release manifest manually or swap artifact after approval.
acceptance.acceptance: Integrity mismatch blocks promotion.

acceptance.title: Supported limits
acceptance.behaviour: Publish exact runtime/provider/profile limits and known exclusions.
acceptance.exercise: Attempt unsupported framework feature or capacity above qualified envelope.
acceptance.acceptance: System fails clearly or applies declared limit, not silent wrong behavior.
